text: This item is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. It is to obtain approval to prohibit parking from 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Downsview Avenue, from a point 30 metres west of Highview Avenue to Privet Road. Residents on this portion of Downsview Avenue have requested these day-time parking prohibitions because of workers and visitors to the Humber River Regional Hospital who park along this portion of the road and often exceed the statutory 3 hour parking limit.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Downsview Avenue, from a point 30 metres west of Highview Avenue to Privet Road.
